# ConsumerShield

> ConsumerShield provides comprehensive legal guidance and attorney matching services for product liability, personal injury, and consumer protection claims.

ConsumerShield is a consumer-focused legal information platform offering detailed guides on major lawsuits, injury cases, and legal rights. The site features expert-authored content on pharmaceutical litigation, environmental contamination, accident liability, and settlement updates, with resources to connect users with qualified attorneys.

## Key Topics

- Product Liability
- Class Action Lawsuits
- Personal Injury Law
- Consumer Protection
- Settlement Updates
- MDL (Multidistrict Litigation)
- Roundup Glyphosate
- PFAS Contamination
- Cancer Claims
- Pharmaceutical Litigation
- Premises Liability
- Workers' Compensation
- Legal Guides
- Attorney Matching
- Case Review

## Product Liability Lawsuits

- [Product Liability | ConsumerShield](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability): Guide explaining product liability laws and how compensation lawsuits work.
- [Roundup Lawsuit: Latest Updates & Guide (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/roundup): Roundup glyphosate lawsuit guide with $11B settlement info and attorney matching.
- [Talcum Powder Lawsuit: Guide & Latest Updates (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/talcum-powder): Talcum powder lawsuit guide covering Johnson & Johnson litigation and cancer claims.
- [Hair Relaxer Lawsuit: Guide & Latest Updates (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/hair-relaxer): Hair relaxer lawsuit guide addressing uterine cancer and health injury claims.
- [Ozempic Lawsuit Guide: Latest Updates (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/ozempic): Ozempic weight loss drug lawsuit guide addressing gastroparesis and vision loss.
- [Depo Provera Lawsuit Guide: Latest Updates (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/depo-provera): Depo-Provera lawsuit guide covering side effects, Pfizer litigation, and 2026 updates.
- [Paraquat Lawsuit Guide: Latest Updates (2026)](https://www.consumershield.com/product-liability/paraquat): Paraquat herbicide lawsuit guide addressing Parkinson's disease litigation.

- [Bicycle Accident | Types, Causes & Legal Help | ConsumerShield](https://www.consumershield.com/injuries-accidents/bike-accidents): Bicycle accident legal guide covering motor vehicle liability and cyclist safety.
